args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

tests/test_money.py expects ROUND_HALF_EVEN but src/money.py was using
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing the nightly build to fail.

args.body:
## Problem
The nightly build fails: `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py::round_money` was implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Fix
Switch the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so half-values round to the nearest even cent (e.g. `2.665 -> 2.66`, `2.675 -> 2.68`).

## Verification
- CI run ci-0001 on this branch: **passed** (including `tests/test_money.py`).

Merging this so the fix ships in today's release.
